description: Behaviour cases for authentication-flow-reviewer (6 domain-specific cases).

cases.prompt: Review our authentication as one flow set: login, logout, reset, MFA and session refresh.

assertions: Maps all named flows with failure/recovery branches and checks server-side revocation.
Flags a cross-flow gap; no live test claimed.

cases.prompt: Before SSO launch, review the federation and account-linking flows and their failure paths.

assertions: Covers SSO callback and account-linking conflict handling, and states whether IdP session logout is verified or unverified.
Names the account-linking resolution and audit requirement.

cases.prompt: The password reset journey is inconsistent with login - review the full auth flow matrix.

assertions: Reviews the reset journey against login (token binding, session revocation after reset, rate limits).
States the evidence required to prove reset behaviour.

cases.prompt: Human agent trust reviewer work: handle the deliverable end-to-end for our system.

assertions: Routes the request to the real neighbouring owner named in the prompt.
Does not claim to have run any inspection or execution it did not run.

cases.prompt: Review MFA enrollment and recovery edge cases and the re-authentication paths.

assertions: Enumerates MFA enrolment/verification/recovery edge cases with expected behaviour.
Names the re-authentication requirement for sensitive actions.

cases.prompt: Map token and session lifecycle across our login, refresh and logout flows and report gaps.

assertions: Produces the token/session lifecycle table with rotation and reuse-detection expectations.
Checks logout revocation server-side and marks unknowns.
